notes: Fields0..97 retain indexes. flowRate is selected pressure flow; shiftNet is signed revenue minus operating costs and wages, excluding upgrades.
accuracy is final beverage fill only. Visible foam mess (spill) and actual beverageWasteMl have separate economic consequences.
Patience runs from the first changed recipe selection or first hold while active service; reading an untouched ticket, mandatory paid settling, review and menus do not consume it.
staffSales is actual cumulative secondary-lane gross; staffOrders can increase after each scored player cup. queuedDemand includes demand not yet served or lost.
refund and shiftRefunds show foregone menu sale value, not a second cash deduction. ingredientCost/cleanupCost are actual cash charges capped by spendable cash to keep a recovery path.
modeMultiplier reflects the committed receipt in review/closed phases, even when the selected next difficulty changes.
Fields98..123 append recipe preparation. selectedSoda4 means unchosen; begin_pour requires0..3. set_recipe may use4 to prepare garnish before selecting a base.
accuracy and fillStars measure liquid fill only. Overall stars also cap at recipe grade: exact100=5,80+=4,60+=3,40+=2,lower=1. Recipe errors never falsify the displayed fill score.

recipeMistakes is a bit mask: base1, cherries2, lime4, syrup8, blend16. Blend0=light/extra soda water,1=regular,2=bold. recipeFizzMultiplier is the selected blend gas multiplier, independent of tap pressure.

hasCitrus/hasSyrup/hasMixer report owned station levels. Buying a station does not change the existing request; future generated requests may use it. selectedAddinCost is the selected garnish/syrup quote in cents, charged only when committed, not on each edit.

Fields124..133 append two-soda orders. orderedSecondSoda4 means a single soda. firstShare is1 for singles or0.25/0.5/0.75 for mixed orders. pourPart0 is the first soda;1 is the second. selectedSoda remains the first chosen base; activeSoda auto-routes the second tap.

attempted remains a cup-wide lock for recipes, mode, pressure and purchases. partAttempted controls the current hold budget. Hardcore end_pour advances the first part with no payment; final release serves. Easy serve advances the first part and serves the last; each part requires an attempt.

activeTarget is a fraction of total cup capacity: target*firstShare on the first mix part and target on the final part. firstBeverageMl excludes foam gas and accounts for proportional overflow losses. It is fixed after the final score.

mixAccuracy=clamp(100-200*abs(first retained beverage/total retained beverage-firstShare),0,100). Empty mixed cups score0 for mix; singles report100. mixStars uses fill-grade thresholds. Overall stars are the minimum of fill, recipe and mix grades.

Mixed orders begin on customer6, initially half/half. Subsequent orders mix about one in three; quarter shares appear after12 completed manual customers. Mixed requests use at most one simple add-in and regular water blend. Their first base is preselected without starting prep time.

Version104 stores120 doubles. Legacy101 uses80 values, zero-padded to120;102 and103 use their original120 values. Legacy current cups remain single-soda and preserve their original payments and recipes.

save_ptr refreshes buffer from live state: call once, write all120 doubles, then restore_save. Validation is atomic; reserved105..119 must be zero for104, while original reserved ranges are enforced for legacy versions.

V101/V102 current orders migrate as plain recipes with their original soda selected and no retroactive garnish charges. V103 current recipes and every original124 snapshot field preserve released restore behavior.

For104, attempted remains cup-global and partAttempted belongs to pourPart. Interrupted Hardcore first-part saves advance to the untouched second part without paying; untouched second-part saves survive repeat reloads; interrupted final-part saves commit once. Single-soda102/103/104 Hardcore holds retain their one-time commit behavior.

An unfinished Easy cup restores stopped in Easy, keeps its current part, and returns to Hardcore after the cup. Unpoured preparation restores without consuming a hold. Paid cups serialize settled beverage and never replay sales.

Fields101..103 store first-soda physical pools, and104 stores total first-soda input for ingredient cost. First and second foam retain their own soda settling rates. Paid mixed cups store the committed first beverage in101 and zero foam in102/103.

lastScoredHardcore locks receipt mode premium even when the next selected mode changes. Mixed menu prices use requested base proportions plus60 cents; actual input volumes set supply costs; selected add-ins charge once at final service.

rules.targetSelection: All requests from 45, 55, 60, 65, 70, 75, and 80 percent remain available for every soda, cup, mode, and tap level. The first career order remains 65 percent Orange.
rules.scoredVolume: Final free+trapped beverage, capped by capacity. Fill score=100-350*absolute fill fraction error. Gas does not count as beverage or ingredient waste.
rules.reviewSettling: Phase 1 step advances only the existing cup physics with pouring disabled. Elapsed service time, score, payout, and career state remain final. Phase 2 step does nothing.
rules.service: Patience starts on first changed recipe selection or first hold. New orders allow2seconds for base selection plus1.5seconds per requested add-in action or nonregular blend; mixes add2seconds for their second part. Reading an untouched ticket and paid settling/review/menu time are free. Slow service reduces tips and eventually sale value/demand. Specialist work retains at most10seconds of actual service per nonempty final committed cup;3.5s/order divided by(1+0.2*activeTraining).
rules.pressure: Chosen only on an untouched cup. All3 pressure settings and all targets exist in both modes; Gentle keeps every tested single-soda and two-soda catalog request five-star reachable while retaining visible fizz.
rules.recipe: Starter cherries0..2. Lime0..1 requires item9, syrup0..2 requires item10, nonregular water blend requires item11. Recipe edits lock on the first hold for the whole cup. Premiums: cherries40c each,lime35c,syrup50c per pump,nonregular water blend25c,two-soda mix60c. Mixed base prices weight requested shares. Selected add-ins charge once: cherries8c,lime10c,syrup12c. Actual per-soda input volumes set liquid ingredient costs. Garnishes do not change fill volume.
rules.recipeScore: Recipe accuracy=100-60wrong first base-15per cherry difference-20lime difference-20per syrup difference-20per water-blend step, clamped0..100. Mix accuracy=clamp(100-200*absolute retained-first-share error,0,100), with0 for empty mixes and100 for singles. Overallstars=min(fillStars,recipeStars,mixStars). Five stars require the exact recipe and96+fill andmix scores.
rules.recipeGeneration: Fresh first customer requests Orange and one cherry. The first5 customers are single-soda; customer6 guarantees half/half. Later mixes occur about1in3, with quarter shares introduced after12 completed manual customers. Mixed requests use distinct bases, at most one simple add-in, and regular water blend; their first base is preselected without prep time. Single-soda requests retain plain breaks, owned ingredients and at most two add-in types. Purchases never change the current request.
rules.hardcoreAttemptScope: One hold for a single-soda cup; one hold for each of two ordered sodas. First release advances without scoring; final release commits once.
